title: VirtualFCS-SysVal: Modelica library of a PEM fuel cell system
description: Modelica library with the PEM fuel cell system model of the publication "A Coverage-Aware Validation Process for Physical Energy-System Models: Demonstration on an 80 kW Fuel Cell System in an Industrial Test Environment". It is based on the development state 2.1.0-dev of the open-source library VirtualFCS after its release v2.0.0 (MIT license, Copyright (c) 2021 Virtual-FCS H2020) and is not an official VirtualFCS release. It contains the parameters of the second iteration, and a patch file sets those of the first iteration. The published model uses the default membrane parameters of Hahn (2023).
